institution_matches.overview: Presents TapeSim, a tape dispenser simulator that clusters most of the wound tape into a rigid body while keeping a deformable collar and free strip, enabling realistic unwinding, attachment, and reattachment at much lower computational cost. It achieves 3–8× physics-step speedups and better agreement with real tape behavior, supporting robotic tape-handling tasks like box sealing.

institution_matches.title: M3GD: Multi-Modal Multi-View Geometric Diffusion for Camera--LiDAR Novel View Synthesis
institution_matches.overview: M3GD fuses independently pretrained image and LiDAR foundation models to enable camera–LiDAR novel view synthesis without explicit cross-modal pretraining. By injecting LiDAR-derived geometric descriptors into a multi-view flow-matching generator, it improves RGB and depth prediction on GrandTour and runs on a ground robot with a tunable quality–cost trade-off.

institution_matches.title: Do World Models Make Better Robots? A Survey of Evaluation Benchmarks for Predictive Embodied Intelligence
institution_matches.overview: Surveys 160 benchmarks across policy, embodied-agent, world-model, and prediction-to-action evaluation, highlighting that only 7% explicitly compare world models to direct VLAs and very few execute predictions in closed loop. Proposes a taxonomy and an evaluation protocol aimed at measuring when and how predictive world models yield concrete control advantages.

institution_matches.title: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations
institution_matches.overview: TrackEverything represents videos as persistent 3D scene tracks with voxel-based de-duplication, enabling dense tracking of all visible points over sequences exceeding 1000 frames within 40 GB GPU memory. It combines endpoint and trajectory refinement with an efficient 3D feature sampling scheme, outperforming existing dense 3D trackers on TAPVid-3D by over 20% APD.

institution_matches.title: High-Voltage Optocoupler Amplifier for Electrostatic Actuators
institution_matches.overview: Demonstrates a minimalist high-voltage linear amplifier using optocouplers to drive electrostatic actuators up to 20 kV peak-to-peak with ~500 Hz bandwidth. Operating optocouplers in feedback yields higher bandwidth and lower distortion than comparable PWM designs, simplifying the drive electronics for multi-kilovolt electrostatic actuation.

topic_matches.title: Coding Agents for Generalized Task and Motion Planning Problems
topic_matches.overview: Evaluates coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex on 28 generalized task and motion planning (TAMP) environments, where agents synthesize reusable programs via simulator interaction. Across 98,000 evaluation episodes, these agent-generated programs significantly outperform hand-engineered planners and an LLM generalized planning baseline, maintaining higher success with far less computation as object counts grow.

topic_matches.title: ReVAMP: Vector-Accelerated Motion Planning for Kinematically-Constrained Systems via Reparameterization
topic_matches.overview: Introduces a motion planner that reparameterizes constrained configuration spaces using analytic inverse kinematics so that samples are constraint-satisfying by construction. The approach enables new vectorization strategies, achieving microsecond–millisecond planning for up to 20-DoF systems and up to 10× speedups over state-of-the-art projection-based planners, opening doors to restructuring manipulation pipelines around very fast replanning.

topic_matches.title: Contact as a Decision Variable: Capability-Tradeoff Contact Selection for Legged Loco-Manipulation
topic_matches.overview: Formulates contact selection for legged loco-manipulation as a trade-off between residual wrench, end-effector reach, base mobility, and contact acquisition cost. The proposed CTCS method approximates these capabilities via sensitivity analysis and selective exact evaluations, delivering ~3× speedup over exhaustive evaluation while enabling a Unitree Go2 with arm to choose support surfaces that substantially improve task performance.

topic_matches.title: ADM-Planner: LLM-Guided Long-Horizon Planning for Mobile Manipulators with Attention-Enhanced Dynamic Memory
topic_matches.overview: ADM-Planner combines an LLM planner with an attention-based dynamic memory that separates persistent workspace knowledge from object states and uses a bounded retriever to feed only relevant entries into the prompt. In simulation and real mobile-manipulator experiments, it achieves near-perfect success on long-horizon tasks while drastically reducing context size and planner calls compared to static or unfiltered memory.

topic_matches.title: Body-Grounded Replanning for Physically Adaptive Manipulation
topic_matches.overview: Proposes a body-grounded replanning framework where an LLM selects high-level manipulation strategies based on internal physical state (e.g., joint loads, mobility constraints) and execution history. The approach adapts strategies mid-task without changing low-level controllers, maintaining high success while reducing physical effort in reaching and contact-rich manipulation both in simulation and on real hardware.

topic_matches.title: Res-HIL: Human-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Dexterous Manipulation
topic_matches.overview: Res-HIL learns a residual correction policy on top of a frozen imitation policy using human-in-the-loop interventions that provide both direct residual supervision and reward shaping. Across five contact-rich dexterous tasks, it surpasses full-policy human-in-the-loop RL and unguided residual fine-tuning within about ten minutes of online training, achieving strong improvements with only 20 initial demonstrations.

topic_matches.title: CAMP: Cooperative Arm-Hand Motion Planning in Constrained Spaces
topic_matches.institution: Harbin Institute of Technology; KTH Royal Institute of Technology; Key Laboratory for Multi-target Natural Medicine, China Pharmaceutical University, Nanjing, China; TH Royal Institute; The University of Hong Kong
topic_matches.overview: CAMP models the coupling between arm and hand via feasible hand fibers—collision-free hand configurations attached to each arm pose—and searches layered hand spaces with local arm relaxation. It then compresses candidate trajectories with via-point movement primitives for coarse-to-fine optimization, achieving 84–99% success in constrained manipulation scenarios and validating performance on real robots.

topic_matches.title: CALM: Current Aligned Link Manipulation for Single Arm Oversized Object Lifting
topic_matches.institution: The University of Hong Kong; Tsinghua University
topic_matches.overview: CALM enables whole-arm manipulation of oversized objects using motor currents as load-related feedback, with stage-specific policies for repositioning, grasping, and lifting learned in simulation. A current-mapping module aligns simulated and real actuator currents for sim-to-real transfer, and a unified student policy achieves over 73% success on physical oversized-object lifting without real-world RL.

topic_matches.title: Outcome-Sensitive Motion Search for Impact-Aware Dexterous Catching
topic_matches.institution: University of Science and Technology of China
topic_matches.overview: Introduces Outcome-Sensitive Motion Search, which analyzes the sensitivity of catching outcomes to pre-contact motion and defines an outcome-sensitive window to refine demonstrations from a privileged RL teacher. By learning a manifold of successful pre-contact motions and performing targeted search and validation, the resulting imitation policy surpasses the teacher in both catch success and impact mitigation.

topic_matches.title: GPT-6-Astra Lights Up Embodied Navigation: Evaluation in Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
topic_matches.overview: Assesses GPT-6-Astra as a zero-shot agent for continuous vision-and-language navigation, where it chooses when to observe, how to move, and when to stop using only monocular RGB. On the R2R-CE benchmark it achieves a 79% success rate, substantially outperforming prior zero-shot and supervised systems, while exposing remaining challenges in route execution and goal verification.
